newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 1 PM.

text.p: * President Ion Iliescu has officialy registered his candidacy in November 3 elections with the Central Electoral Bureau (BEC).
BEC sources said more than 400,000 signatures supported Iliescu's candidacy.
* The deadline for registering presidential candidacies expires 30 days before polls, BEC chairman, judge Costica Ionescu said.
* Iliescu started campaigning in Buzau county.

* Senate voted a railway transportation bill which splits the country's SNCFR railway authority into infrastructure administrators and rolling stock operators, thus allowing the infrastructure to be used by several state or private operators.
* Lower Chamber of Deputies resumed debates on bill to modify the criminal code. Deputies discussed article no 200 on homosexual relations.
Representatives of the Greater Romania Party and the National Unity Party quoted religious and health arguements to demand that homosexual relations be punished even when they take place in intimacy.

National Peasant Party deputies demanded that the term "public scandal" -- used in a previous version of the bill to designate the cases when homosexual relations can be punished -- be cut out, saying it was confusing and would stir problems in law enforcement.
Debates were adjourned for Monday, Sept 9.

* Some 340 cases were registered in a viral meningitis epidemics, with 201 patients in capital Bucharest. No new patients were hospitalised on Thursday, while 124 were declared cured. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
